newsitem.title: USA: Earthgrains to buy bakery CooperSmith.
newsitem.headline: Earthgrains to buy bakery CooperSmith.

text.p: Earthgrains Co said Friday it agreed to acquire CooperSmith Inc, an operator of eight packaged bread, bun and roll bakeries.

Earthgrains said the deal was for cash but did not disclose terms. CooperSmith had net sales of about $250 million last year and owns Kern's Bakeries, Smith's Bakeries, Waldensian Bakery and My Bread Bakery.
"This acquisition will yield improved operating efficiency, profitable growth opportunities and increased branded sales," Earthgrains' Chairman and Chief Executive Barry Beracha said in a statement.
"We are taking advantage of industry consolidation opportunities to further improve our ability to serve customers, satisfy consumers and enhance shareholder value."

CooperSmith employs about 3,000 workers and operates 900 direct-customer delivery routes. It has plants in Mobile, Ala.; Knoxville, Tenn.; London, Ky.; New Bedford, Mass.; Meridian, Miss.; Valdese, N.C.; Greenville, S.C.; and Bristol, Tenn.
